note: Worklist read with usedObjectSet=99999999999999999999999999999999 (LAST_RUN) after the two-package run: 29 findings over 5 objects from 2 packages. Each object row carries adtcore:packageName and adtcore:type="CLAS" with no /OC suffix and no atcfinding:objectTypeId; each finding carries a documentation atom:link, an atcfinding:quickfixes block (every flag false here) and an atcfinding:tags list. capturedBy: Standalone python ADT probe (urllib + cookiejar) driven against the A4H sandbox appliance for issue #78's ATC completeness work. REAL wire recording, not synthetic.
